thesis: The episode introduces Eric Sorensen, CEO of Panagora Asset Management, who discusses his background as a high-performance jet instructor pilot and draws an analogy between piloting complex machines and the combination of human intelligence with modern investment tools. The conversation then transitions to exploring the historical evolution of quantitative investment strategies, noting that when Sorensen began his career, financial economics was just beginning to explode as a field.
